environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) A custom rule group 'inventory-api-protection' containing a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string values using pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with action BLOCK, and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS which inspects all query string parameters using the built-in SQLi detection engine with sensitivity level HIGH. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the SQLi rule group evaluates AFTER the custom regex group.

config.network: ALB SG allows 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0; Task SG allows traffic only from ALB SG
config.waf_web_acl: WAFv2 Web ACL attached to ALB
config.waf_rule_priority_2: Custom rule group 'inventory-api-protection' with RegexPatternSet BLOCK on query strings
config.waf_rule_priority_3: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, all rules BLOCK mode, sensitivity HIGH
